headline: Priorities 1 and 2 are done; priority 3 is half done. Cost does not depend on the mesh in 2D or 3D, and in 2D neither does accuracy; accuracy improves with bank width up to r = 384. But a coarse spectral full solver is faster at equal accuracy (K2 fires in 2D and 3D), and a standard POD reduced model with hyper-reduction beats ours on speed and worst-case error. The paper's case rests on mesh-independent cost and mesh-free evaluation.
